description: Paper Table I -- L1 distance to the nearest integer on two discrete targets. Appendix D verbatim: 'fully connected networks with 2 hidden layers of 512 neurons for both', 'a ReLU activation function in all their hidden layers', 'batches of 500 samples over 40k iterations', 'we update the critic 5 times for each generator update', 'a RMSProp optimizer with a learning rate of 5e-4'. This is the paper-accurate config and costs about 2.8 h per (latent, seed) on one CPU core; see synthetic_datasets_fast.json for a cheaper variant.
